title: { Tlapalli }
text: Ejemplos básicos de ocmo usar nuestras paletas de colores:
code: library(tlapalli) library(ggplot2)  # Ver las paletas disponibles names(tlapalli) #>  [1] "Altata"         "DiaDeMuertos"   "LosTemerarios"  "Atlas"          #>  [5] "Duvalin"        "Tecate"         "LosTemerarios2" "Alicante"       #>  [9] "Jade"           "Obsidiana"      "Ambar"          "Cempasuchil"    #> [13] "Mazatlan"       "Atlas2"         "CartaBlanca"    "PacificoClara"  #> [17] "PacificoLight"  "PacificoSuave"  "Conchas"        "Venado8"        #> [21] "Coqueta"        "Quetzal"        "Ofrenda"        "Cosecha"        #> [25] "Valle"  # Obtener los colores de una paleta tlapalli_pal("Ambar") #> [1] "#06291f" "#7d3a26" "#c95d39" "#ccad46" "#dce9dd"  # Interpolar colores para obtener una paleta de 10 colores tlapalli_pal("Ambar", n = 10, type = "continuous") #>  [1] "#06281F" "#413322" "#703925" "#95452C" "#B75434" "#CA703B" "#CC9341" #>  [8] "#CFB357" "#D9CD9A" "#DCE9DD" # Escala continua en ggplot2 ggplot(faithfuld, aes(waiting, eruptions, fill = density)) +    geom_tile() +    scale_fill_tlapalli_c("Atlas2") +    theme_minimal() # Escala discreta en ggplot2 ggplot(mpg, aes(class, fill = class)) +   geom_bar() +   scale_fill_tlapalli_d("Quetzal") +   theme_bw() # Paleta discreta en R base barplot(1:6, col = tlapalli_pal("PacificoSuave")) # Paleta continua en R base image(volcano, col = tlapalli_pal("Ambar", n = 100, type = "continuous")) # Mostrar paletas de colores en fondo negro tlapalli_show("Venado8", background = "black") tlapalli_show("Altata", n = 100, type = "continuous", background = "both")

title: R color palettes inspired by elements of Mexican and Mesoamerican culture
R color palettes inspired by elements of Mexican and Mesoamerican culture
text: Basic examples use color palettes:
code: library(tlapalli) library(ggplot2)  # List available palettes names(tlapalli) #>  [1] "Altata"         "DiaDeMuertos"   "LosTemerarios"  "Atlas"          #>  [5] "Duvalin"        "Tecate"         "LosTemerarios2" "Alicante"       #>  [9] "Jade"           "Obsidiana"      "Ambar"          "Cempasuchil"    #> [13] "Mazatlan"       "Atlas2"         "CartaBlanca"    "PacificoClara"  #> [17] "PacificoLight"  "PacificoSuave"  "Conchas"        "Venado8"        #> [21] "Coqueta"        "Quetzal"        "Ofrenda"        "Cosecha"        #> [25] "Valle"  # Get the colors of a palette tlapalli_pal("Ambar") #> [1] "#06291f" "#7d3a26" "#c95d39" "#ccad46" "#dce9dd"  # Interpolate colors to get a palette with 10 colors tlapalli_pal("Ambar", n = 10, type = "continuous") #>  [1] "#06281F" "#413322" "#703925" "#95452C" "#B75434" "#CA703B" "#CC9341" #>  [8] "#CFB357" "#D9CD9A" "#DCE9DD" # Continuous scale in ggplot2 ggplot(faithfuld, aes(waiting, eruptions, fill = density)) +    geom_tile() +    scale_fill_tlapalli_c("Atlas2") +    theme_minimal() # Discrete scale in ggplot2 ggplot(mpg, aes(class, fill = class)) +   geom_bar() +   scale_fill_tlapalli_d("Quetzal") +   theme_bw() # Discrete palette in base R barplot(1:6, col = tlapalli_pal("PacificoSuave")) # Continuous palette in base R image(volcano, col = tlapalli_pal("Ambar", n = 100, type = "continuous")) # Show color palettes tlapalli_show("Venado8", background = "black") tlapalli_show("Altata", n = 100, type = "continuous", background = "both")

title: Get colors from a palette — tlapalli_pal
text: name Name palette (see names(tlapalli)). n Number colors return. NULL (default), returns original colors palette. type "discrete" takes first n colors; "continuous" interpolates create n colors. direction Direction palette. 1 (default) uses original order; -1 reverses .

Show a palette — tlapalli_show
text: Plots palette white /black background. Optionally, shows simulations looks deuteranopia, protanopia, tritanopia grayscale. Palettes 15 colors drawn continuous bar.

title: Show a palette — tlapalli_show
code: tlapalli_show(   name,   n = NULL,   type = c("discrete", "continuous"),   direction = 1,   background = c("white", "black", "both"),   simulations = TRUE )

title: Show a palette — tlapalli_show
text: name Name palette (see names(tlapalli)). n Number colors return. NULL (default), returns original colors palette. type "discrete" takes first n colors; "continuous" interpolates create n colors. direction Direction palette. 1 (default) uses original order; -1 reverses . background "white" (default) "black" draws single panel; "" draws white black panel. simulations Logical. TRUE (default), shows color vision deficiency simulations grayscale version original colors.

title: Show a palette — tlapalli_show
text: palette colors character vector, invisibly.

title: tlapalli 0.0.1
text: Initial release. 27 color palettes, available discrete continuous scales. tlapalli_pal() returns colors palette. Color interpolation extend palette number colors. Discrete continuous fill colour scales ggplot2. tlapalli_show() previews palettes shows look different color vision deficiencies grayscale.
